What roofing crews order

Built for the work

  • Bright, high-contrast crew tees that stand out from the street
  • Sun-protective long sleeves for hot roof days
  • Hi-vis shirts and hoodies for street-side work
  • Hoodies, beanies and jackets for cold-season jobs

Tips for roofing & siding uniforms

  • Use a big, simple back print - it's readable from the street and the yard sign does the rest.
  • Bright colors like safety green, orange or gold make crews easy to spot on a roof.
  • Order a summer tee and a long sleeve so the crew is covered all year.

Company orders

How crew and company orders work

1

Send your logo & headcount

Tell us the garments, colors and roughly how many people. Email your logo to meadowprintsembroidery@gmail.com - any file works.

2

Get a quote & proof

You get a quote and a digital proof within 24 hours. Volume pricing kicks in automatically on larger orders.

3

Send your size run

Send sizes (and names, if you want them stitched) as a simple list. Mixed sizes and tall sizes are fine.

4

Reorder any time

We keep your logo and order details on file, so restocking for new hires is one call or email.
